prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign) and home (new_flow) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome (+7.8% vs -6.3%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, supported by 3 tests with positive noise-corrected results and 1 winning test (+8.1%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 2 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Pet Selection and Customization Screen: Redesign the companion selection screen into a two-column view showing pet options and traits side-by-side. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion time (mean 1017s).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Recovery Hint: Add explicit contextual guidance explaining that signing in syncs previously saved pets to prevent account reset confusion. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time and Progress Status Display: Display real-time pet generation progress with explicit timer guidance on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting stage has a high mean time (2336s) and pet rendering failure reports.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Pet Visibility and Display Location Setup Screen: Insert a dedicated new onboarding screen before home intro to confirm pet desktop display settings. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open properly.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Companion Path Value Headline Update: Update the choose path headline and body text to clarify path options and immediate companion benefits. (why: Choose path screen has high average drop-off time (mean 514s).)
5: [finish, redesign] Mascot Desktop Interaction Cards Layout: Redesign home intro into a structured card layout presenting core pet interaction controls clearly. (why: Multiple support emails highlighted confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets post-onboarding.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Compact Centered Sign-In Interface: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout to reduce visual friction and streamline authentication. (why: Sign-in mean time is 567s despite high conversion, indicating lingering visual friction.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Render Notification Alert: Enable system notification alerts when pet creation finishes so users know when their pet is active. (why: Users experience long waiting times (mean 2336s) and uncertainty about whether the pet rendered.)
8: [choose_path, reorder] Story Overview Sequence Prioritization: Reorder sequence emphasis and enable step counter on path selection screen. (why: Overall onboarding conversion is 23.9% and choose path mean time is high (514s).)

scores.note: Adoption has the highest drop-off (39.1%), but past redesign test showed minimal gain (+0.4%) and requires screen overhaul.
Strong support mail alignment (8 emails) and low-cost text update on sign-in, a step type that historically responds well.
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) and failure reports with explicit progress UI.
Adding new screens to finish stage has poor historical performance (-0.3% average) and requires a full release.
Low cost text update addressing high mean time (514s) at initial path selection.
Directly targets multiple post-onboarding user support emails, though redesign effort is high.
Sign-in optimizations show consistent historical success, helping streamline 567s mean completion time.
Mitigates high home wait duration (2336s) by notifying users externally when pet creation finishes.
Reordering sequence and adding step counter may clarify path selection and reduce initial drop-off.
